testRunner: Both normal cases passed together on the preceding build. The final positive case passed with explicit assertions for 2 lb, $4.00 and $38.00. In the combined final run an XCTest accessibility callback terminated the app when starting the second case. The same final binary passed the conditional case in isolation.
journey: Shop → enter a two-item pickup → review checkout copy → whole checkout. With $34 of other items, $38 cap, $2/lb and a 0.01 lb billing increment, unconfirmed tax leaves the maximum unresolved. An independent normal-entry journey with confirmed zero tax shows a maximum of 2 lb, a $4.00 line and $38.00 pickup. Returning to checkout leaves the actual weighed price blank.
coverage: Saved quote and cap must refer to the same commitments and to a current, complete whole pickup. Inclusive-only prices, missing line identity and unconfirmed monetary components stay unresolved.

The solver uses the entered discrete billing increment and confirmed fractional-cent rounding where required. It checks the actual affordable increment against fee thresholds, ineligible items and discounts. A discounted or fee-waived heavier basket can fit even when a lighter basket costs more.
Price, unit and weight choices are a read-only local estimate. Changing the item or mass unit clears its entered rate and increment.
limits: The native journey ran in English. English and US Spanish catalog entries were checked for structural coverage. The local fixture uses entered retail terms without a live retailer or physical scale.
localization: Frozen source passed 13 catalogs and 3,025 English/US Spanish entries. US Spanish has not had human language review.
